body.basic_vars:
- `{user}` mention; `{author}` / `{member}` name; `{id}` / `{authorid}` user ID
- `{authoravatar}` avatar URL; `{authorbanner}` banner URL; `{authorcreated}` account creation time
- `{guild}` / `{server}` server name; `{guildid}` server ID
- `{guildicon}` icon URL; `{guildbanner}` banner URL; `{guildowner}` / `{guildownerid}` owner
- `{guildmembers}` member count; `{guildroles}` role count; `{guildboosts}` boost count
- `{content}` / `{channel}` / `{role}`
- `{null}` empty string, useful for `if` comparisons
- `\n` newline, `\t` tab
body.builtin_packs:
- `daily_greetings`: morning / afternoon / evening / generic greetings
- `mini_commands`: !say / !time / !date / !roll
- `chat_fun`: check-in / pick someone / daily fortune / hype reactions
- Apply one directly with {template}
body.commands:
{add}: add a rule
{edit} / {remove}: modify or delete a rule
{quickadd}: quickly append trigger / response
{template}: apply a built-in template pack
{list} / {clear}: view or clear rules
{export} / {import_}: export or import JSON
{ignore}: configure global ignore/allow channels
{test}: preview variables, conditions, and embed output
body.date_condition:
- `{date}` `{year}` `{month}` `{day}`
- `{time}` `{time24}` `{hour}` `{minute}` `{second}`
- `{timemd:t}` ~ `{timemd:R}` produce a Discord timestamp
- `{contentsplit:0}`, `{contentsplit:1-}`, `{contentsplit:-4}`, `{contentsplit:1-2}`
- `{math:(1+2*3)}`, only `+ - * /` supported, numbers limited to `-1000 ~ 1000`
- other variables can be used inside `math`, e.g. `{math:({contentsplit:1}+5)}`
- `{if:{contentsplit:1}==true:Yes:else:No}`
- `{if:{contentsplit:1}!={null}:Has content:else:Empty}`
- also supports `{if:{contentsplit:1}==true:Yes:No}` and `{if:condition:content if true}`
- supports `==` `!=` `<=` `>=` `&&` `||`
body.delay_state_vars:
- `{newmsg:2}`: sends a new message after 1~3s, up to 2
- `{edit:2}`: edits this autoreply after 1~3s, up to 4
- only user mentions are allowed by default; `{mention:true}` allows `@everyone` / roles, `{mention:false}` turns it off
- `{uservar:key}` / `{uservar:key:value}`
- `{guildvar:key}` / `{guildvar:key:value}`
- up to 5 uservars, 10 guildvars, key/value max length 100
body.embed_advanced:
- `{random}` / `{randint:min-max}` / `{random_user}`
- `{react:emoji}`, `{sticker:sticker_id}`
- `{embedtitle:title}` `{embeddescription:content}` `{embedurl:link}`
- `{embedimage:link}` `{embedthumbnail:link}`
- `{embedcolor:HEX}` `{embedfooter:text}` `{embedfooterimage:link}`
- `{embedauthor:name}` `{embedauthorurl:link}` `{embedauthorimage:link}`
- `{embedtime:true}` `{embedfield:field name:field value}`
- Other variables can still be used inside the embed text
body.notes:
- At most 3 auto-replies per guild per second
- A template syntax error just produces an empty string
- Date / time variables follow the bot host's local timezone
body.special_trigger:
- `type:join`: only triggers on the member-join system message (`discord.MessageType.new_member`)
- `type:boost`: only triggers on the server-boost system message (`discord.MessageType.premium_guild_subscription`)
- A native Discord name also works directly, e.g. `type:premium_guild_tier_1`

help.examples_body:
1) `Welcome {user} to {guild}!`
2) `{if:{contentsplit:1}==true&&{hour}>=12:You entered true in the afternoon:Not met yet}`
3) `{if:{contentsplit:1}!={null}:You entered a parameter:else:No parameter entered}`
4) `{embedtitle:Checked in}{embedurl:https://example.com}{embeddescription:{user} checked in at {date} {time24}}{embedauthor:System}{embedauthorimage:{authoravatar}}{embedcolor:57F287}`
5) `Starting from the 2nd word: {contentsplit:1-}`
6) `Random pick from chat just now: {random_user}`
7) `{mention:true}@everyone Maintenance starting`
8) Write `type:boost` or `type:join` as the trigger to listen for system messages
